fields.tender_title: Construction of Water Treatment Plant with O&M for Five Years

questions.query: What is the liquidated damages rate for delay?
questions.gold_span: In the event of delay in completion, liquidated damages shall be levied at 0.5% of the contract value per fortnight of delay, subject to an overall ceiling of 15% of the total contract value.

questions.query: What is the performance bank guarantee requirement?
questions.gold_span: The successful bidder shall furnish a performance bank guarantee equal to 3% of the contract value, valid for 30 months from the date of award.

questions.query: What is the warranty period required?
questions.gold_span: All supplied equipment shall carry a comprehensive on-site warranty of 1 years from the date of successful commissioning.

questions.query: What is the limitation of liability cap?
questions.gold_span: The aggregate liability of the contractor under this contract shall not exceed 100% of the total contract value, save in cases of fraud, wilful misconduct or breach of confidentiality obligations.

questions.query: What is the minimum years of experience required?
questions.gold_span: The bidder shall have a minimum of 3 years of experience in executing projects of a similar nature in the field of Civil Works.
The bidder shall hold valid ISO 20000-1:2018 and ISO 27001:2022 certifications as on the date of bid submission.

questions.query: Are joint ventures or consortiums allowed?
questions.gold_span: Joint ventures and consortium bids are permitted, subject to a maximum of two members and submission of a registered joint venture agreement.

questions.query: Is sub-contracting allowed and to what extent?
questions.gold_span: Sub-contracting of the awarded work is permitted only up to 30% of the total contract value, and only with the prior written approval of the Purchaser.

questions.query: What is the dispute resolution mechanism?
questions.gold_span: Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this contract shall be referred to arbitration under the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules, with Bengaluru as the seat of arbitration.

questions.query: In what language must bid documents be submitted?
questions.gold_span: All bid documents, correspondence and deliverables shall be submitted in English.

questions.query: What is the payment milestone schedule?
questions.gold_span: Payments shall be released against milestones as follows: 15% as mobilisation advance against an equivalent bank guarantee, 50% on delivery and installation, and the balance 35% on final acceptance testing and handover.

questions.query: What is the contract execution duration?
questions.gold_span: The contract shall be executed over a period of 18 months from the date of issue of the letter of award.

questions.query: What is the proposal submission deadline?
questions.gold_span: The last date and time for submission of bids is 1 November 2027 at 15:00 hours IST.

questions.query: When is the pre-bid meeting scheduled?
questions.gold_span: A pre-bid meeting shall be convened on 17 October 2027 at the office of the Central Public Works Organisation.

questions.query: What is the tender document fee?
questions.gold_span: A non-refundable tender document fee of Rs. 2,000 shall be paid online at the time of bid submission.

questions.query: What is the minimum annual turnover requirement?
questions.gold_span: The bidder shall have achieved a minimum average annual turnover of INR 10,00,00,000 in each of the last three audited financial years.

questions.query: What is the Earnest Money Deposit amount?
questions.gold_span: Bids shall be accompanied by an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of Rs. 5 lakhs, furnished as a demand draft or an unconditional bank guarantee.

questions.query: Is a bank solvency certificate required?
questions.gold_span: A bank solvency certificate is not required for this procurement. Audited financial statements for the last three years shall be sufficient.

questions.query: What is the bid validity period?
questions.gold_span: Bids shall remain valid for a period of 120 days from the date of opening of the technical bid.
